title: Guardian Storage Encryption Envelope
description: At-rest representation of one encrypted Guardian storage payload (state_json or delta_payload). Stored in the existing jsonb column / filesystem JSON file in place of the plaintext payload. A payload is treated as encrypted iff it validates against this schema; in an encryption-enabled deployment a payload that does not validate is a read error, never returned as plaintext.

alg.description: AEAD algorithm. Additional algorithms may be added in later schema versions.

kid.description: Identifier of the key the ciphertext was produced under. Resolved by the StorageKeyProvider; supports rotation and multi-key reads.

nonce.description: Per-encryption AEAD nonce (96-bit / 12 bytes for AES-256-GCM), base64-encoded. Freshly random for every encryption; never reused under one key.

ct.description: Ciphertext with the appended authentication tag, base64-encoded. AAD bound to record identity is authenticated but not stored here (reconstructed from plaintext routing fields at decrypt time).
